title: Mr C Residences Boca Raton
description: A two-colour hospitality palette: brick Venetian red for whole bands, bars and the pill button, pale blush for the alternate bands with red text, white text on red, and a peach line colour for patterns. One geometric sans (Montserrat) in all caps for headings and labels; square edges, flat, 1px lines.
notes: light is the faithful mode; dark is a sibling with an oxblood-black background, blush text and the same red bands
primary is the red of whole bands (text on it is primary-foreground); background is the blush band colour
highlight is the peach line colour of the patterns; glow is a near-black brown used for tints over media
radius is 0: only the submit pill (rounded-full) and the brand panel are round
gutter 16px on phones, 40px from 1024px; section-y is the split band's padding (40px / 232px)
